# IIT Madras test invoices

Generated by `scripts/prepare_iitm_samples.py`, which also adds the purchase orders.

Upload `correct` first, in numbered order, then `incorrect`. Incorrect 06 and 09 depend on correct 01 and 11. To start again, delete those runs in the app.

Every vendor is fictional, and every GSTIN, PAN and bank account is a placeholder. Each invoice carries a small footer saying it is a test document.

## Correct

| File | Quality | What it tests | PO | Expected | At the pause |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `01-clear-digital.pdf` | Clear digital PDF | Matches the PO exactly | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0417 | Accept | - |
| `02-clean-scan-with-freight.pdf` | Clean scan | Freight and CGST/SGST add up to the PO | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0418 | Accept | - |
| `03-skewed-scan.pdf` | Skewed scan, 3.5 degrees | Exact match | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0419 | Accept | - |
| `04-blurry-scan.pdf` | Blurry scan | Exact match | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0420 | Accept | - |
| `05-noisy-scan.pdf` | Noisy, speckled scan | Exact match | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0421 | Accept | - |
| `06-fax-copy.pdf` | Low-resolution black and white fax | Exact match | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0422 | Accept | - |
| `07-phone-photo.pdf` | Phone photo, angled with uneven light | Exact match | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0423 | Accept | - |
| `08-faint-scan.pdf` | Faint, pale scan | PO quoted only indirectly, without the IITM prefix | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0425 | Accept | - |
| `09-rotated-scan.pdf` | Scanned sideways, 90 degrees | Exact match | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0426 | Accept | - |
| `10-two-page-digital.pdf` | Clear digital, 2 pages, 12 items | Long itemised invoice matches the PO | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0427 | Accept | - |
| `11-split-bill-first-month.pdf` | Clear digital | First monthly bill on a six-month PO, so partial billing | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0424 | Accept | - |
| `12-billed-in-kg-po-in-tonnes.pdf` | Clear digital PDF | Billed as 2,000 kg against a PO for 2 tonnes | IITM/PUR/2026-27/0435 | Accept | - |
